feed_urls.label: Feed URLs
feed_urls.description: The RSS feed URLs of the podcasts to subscribe to. Press Enter after each URL. You can also find a podcast with the search and add it to your library.

directory_search.label: Search the Apple Podcasts directory
directory_search.description: Also show matching podcasts from the Apple Podcasts directory in search results, so you can find new podcasts by name and add them. Your search terms are sent to Apple.

country.label: Directory country
country.description: The Apple Podcasts store to search. Podcasts available in other countries may not show up.

manifest.description: Subscribe to any number of podcasts by their RSS feeds in a single provider.
